project_title: CineMind AI - Liquid Glass & Neo-Brutalist Movie Discovery Engine

theme.primary_archetype: Cinematic Dark + Liquid Glassmorphism + Neo-Brutalist Accents

typography.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-none

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism_card: relative rounded-2xl bg-white/[0.03] backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 shadow-[0_8px_32px_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.36)] hover:border-rose-500/40 hover:bg-white/[0.05] transition-all duration-300
visual_enhancers.neo_brutalist_badge: px-3 py-1 rounded-md font-mono text-xs font-bold border border-rose-500/50 bg-rose-950/40 text-rose-300 uppercase tracking-wider shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_rgba(225,29,72,0.6)]
visual_enhancers.liquid_glow: before:absolute before:-inset-px before:rounded-2xl before:bg-gradient-to-r before:from-rose-500/20 before:via-cyan-500/10 before:to-purple-500/20 before:opacity-0 hover:before:opacity-100 before:transition-opacity before:duration-500
visual_enhancers.poster_card_aspect: aspect-[2/3] object-cover rounded-xl shadow-lg border border-white/10 group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-500

component_structure.auth_landing: Hero banner with ambient neon glow, Google Login button with high-contrast glass styling, source highlights (Simkl + Trakt.tv + Plex + Ollama AI), feature teaser bento grid.
component_structure.connections_page: Liquid glass form cards for entering Simkl OAuth/token, Trakt.tv Client ID/Secret, Plex Server URL & Token, and Ollama Endpoint (URL + Model name, e.g. llama3/mistral). Real-time test connection badges.
component_structure.dashboard_stats: Letterboxd/Plex-inspired watch history dashboard with aggregate statistics: Total Hours Watched, Movies vs Shows pie chart, Favorite Genres radar/bar chart, Top Directors & Actors pills, Recent Watch Timeline scroll.
component_structure.taste_profile: AI-generated qualitative summary card ('Your Cinematic DNA') with key tropes, mood preference sliders, narrative complexity rating, and custom AI prompt tuner.
component_structure.ai_recommendations_grid: Poster-heavy poster grid view with liquid glass overlay on hover. Shows poster image, Title, Release Year, Match Score %, 'Why This Recommendation' AI summary modal/tooltip, Save to Library button, and Dismiss button.
component_structure.saved_library: Personal watchlist categorized by 'Must Watch', 'Saved AI Picks', and 'Completed'. Filters by genre, media type, and source.
component_structure.recommendation_modal: Full-screen or high-blur modal with backdrop poster banner, full synopsis, cast, TMDB metadata, trailer play preview, Ollama reasoning breakdown, and streaming availability tags.

testing_requirements.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components, buttons, tabs, modal controls, and stat cards MUST include a descriptive data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard JavaScript/React components (.js or .jsx). Do not generate TypeScript errors.
Follow Liquid Glassmorphism for containers: use bg-white/[0.03], backdrop-blur-xl, border border-white/10, rounded-2xl.

Incorporate Neo-Brutalist touches: crisp 1px borders, subtle retro shadow offsets on active pills/badges (e.g., shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_#E11D48]), and JetBrains Mono fonts for data chips & AI model tags.
Ensure dark theme background #08090E is rich with radial ambient gradients (rose-500/10, cyan-500/10) to give cinematic depth.
Ensure all mock data for Simkl, Trakt, Plex, and Ollama recommendations are highly realistic, complete with posters, TMDb scores, genres, and rich 'Why AI Recommended' explanations.
Implement Sonner toasts for connection testing, saving recommendations, and generating AI taste profiles.
Ensure responsiveness on mobile viewports with smooth tabs/drawer navigation.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without standard full-screen gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as high-contrast linear gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and multi-layered backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). Add targeted CSS transitions for interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Never use generic AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡 for UI icons. Use Lucide icons (lucide-react) or Heroicons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical cramped layouts. Use p-6, p-8, gap-6, gap-8.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
